paragraphs.text: Tetsuko Umezawa (oo-meh-ZAH-wah) is a human rogue of the Clan Umezawa from Dominaria .

Tetsuko is a recent descendant of Clan Umezawa . She practices a form of magic that connects her to a series of magical doorways. She can step freely from any of these doorways to another, evading Bolas 's notice while she plots against him. Tetsuko fought in defense of Dominaria during the New Phyrexian Invasion . A few years later, she ran afoul of Bolas' agents again, continuing to stay one step ahead.

In the Echoverse , Bolas never existed, and Clan Umezawa became a well-known family of bounty hunters on Dominaria. Tetsuko enjoyed hunting down criminals, but didn't share her family's taste for punishing them, preferring the thrill of the chase. She perfected a magical net that captures runaway lawbreakers and teleports them into small stasis spheres for easy transport.
